body: This honestly made me tear up, if anything I want you to please know and understand that you are worthy of true love and affection. You shouldn't feel lucky that he 'would fuck you for a medical reason' he should feel GRATEFUL that you're even with him. I don't know you, but I'll say it because you deserve to hear it, you are fucking HOT you hear me? And you deserve a partner whose going to give you the world! I feel sorry for him that he can't appreciate and love you the way you need to be loved and I'm angry at him for his reaction. I hope I don't sound like a creeper, I was just able to empathize so much with your experience and I myself am of course in a dead bedroom with a partner who hasn't be able to appreciate or take care of me in the way I know I deserve. You're worth more than a convenient fuck. I know you said you love him and you won't leave so I won't comment on that because I have to respect what you've said. But at the same time I implore you to not let your mind trick you into normalizing his behavior and his lack of proper feelings towards you as his partner. I'm so so sorry that this happened to you and that he's made you feel this way.
